about: Analytics files shared byte for byte with scholars-opportunity-fund/sof-web, where each lives under lib/analytics/ with the same name. Each hash is the SHA-256 of the file's UTF-8 text with CRLF normalised to LF. scripts/check-shared-analytics.mjs fails the quality workflow when a file here stops matching. To change one, make the same edit in both repos and update its hash in both manifests.
